title: The Venus Flytrap Snaps Shut in a Tenth of a Second

scenes.text: A plant can slam shut in a tenth of a second.
It's the Venus flytrap, and each trap has tiny trigger hairs inside.
One touch does nothing. It needs two touches within twenty seconds.
That keeps it from snapping at every raindrop.
Once it snaps, at least five more touches seal it tight so it can digest its meal.
A plant that can count to two.

description:
A plant can slam shut in a tenth of a second.
The Venus flytrap only closes when two trigger hairs are touched within about twenty seconds, which keeps raindrops from fooling it.
What is the strangest plant you've ever seen?
first_comment: Would you dare put your finger in one? (It won't hurt, but it will try.)
